messages:
sre-oncall: heads up — seeing sustained apiserver READ latency in eu-central1 since ~08:12UTC. controller-manager leader flips every ~30s and the gpu-provisioner queue is backing up. customers on Dedicated pools reporting slow attach times.

anil: on it, pulling logs now. any symptoms beyond latency?

maria: etctd shows a bunch of fsync stalls and high nvme iowait around the same time. sample from /var/log/syslog:
```
Apr 07 08:11:58 host kernel: INFO: task etcd:2456 blocked for more than 120 seconds.
Apr 07 08:12:01 host kernel: blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 1234567
Apr 07 08:12:12 host kernel: fsync: 120ms
```

chris: gpu-provisioner metrics: backlog ~2100 pending allocs, provision rate dropped to 8/s (was 45/s at 07:50). cost hit estimate ~+12% this hour if we keep spinning up replacements.

infra-bot: ALERT: apiserver_read_latency_p95 eu-central1 >= 520ms (triggered)

anil: looks like etcd WAL fsyncs are stalling which explains apiserver reads timing out and leader election churn in ctrlmgr. ctrlmgr lease renewals failing -> leaders bounce.

maria: confirmed controller-manager logs: "timed out waiting for lease renewal" and "failed to sync endpoints: apiserver timeout". logs:
```
I0407 08:12:20.123456 1 leaderelection.go:245] failed to renew lease: operation timed out
I0407 08:12:20.123467 1 leaderelection.go:252] failed to elect leader: lost connection to apiserver
```

chris: immediate mitigation options? we can: 1) temporary scale down aggressive GPU auto-onboarder jobs, 2) divert non-critical provisioning to west-eu pool, 3) bump etcd IO priority or move leader to healthier node.

sre-oncall: prioritize quick mitigation to restore controlplane stability. Maria/anil take step 1+3. Chris please prep traffic shift plan. I'll own comms to customers.

anil: actioning: 1) cordon one etcd node and promote healthier NVMe node as leader? prefer safe approach: increase etcd commit timeout and WAL fsync retry via env var for the pod. applying small change to etcd statefulset now.

maria: also applying temporary kube-controller-manager flags to increase leader-election duration: --leader-elect-lease-duration=30s -> 60s and --leader-elect-renew-deadline=20s -> 40s to reduce flip frequency. doing a rolling restart of ctrlmgr shards (staggered).

chris: starting a k8s patch to label new nodes in eu-central1 as "provisioning:lowprio" and will add a scheduler predicate to prefer west-eu for new GPU nodes. patch snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  labels:
    provisioning: lowprio
```
apply in 2m.

infra-bot: INFO: Running command `kubectl get pods -n gpu-provisioning -o wide`

sre-oncall: paste output

infra-bot:
```
NAME                         READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
gpu-provisioner-0            1/1     Running            0          18d
gpu-provisioner-1            0/1     CrashLoopBackOff    12         3h
gpu-node-launcher-xyz       0/1     Pending             0          15m
```

maria: CrashLoop on provisioner instance aligns with apiserver throttling. I'm increasing kube-apiserver --max-mutating-requests-inflight and --max-requests-inflight by +20 each on eu-central API servers to reduce rejections for controller loops (will be rolled by infra).

anil: etcd patch applied (WAL retry backoff = 300ms -> 600ms). Prometheus alert thresholds relaxed temporarily. monitoring dashboards show p95 read latency trending down after 30s.

chris: west-eu drain/provision plan ready. rolling new GPU nodes there with dedicated pool allocation. will run a small canary (5 nodes) then ramp.

sre-oncall: good. customer comms sent. ETA for full controlplane steady state ~15-25m.

maria: post-mitigation TODOs: 1) schedule NVMe firmware health check on the affected etcd hosts, 2) provision higher iops instances for etcd leaders, 3) add admission controller to rate-limit bursty gpu requests, 4) run post-incident cost calc for diverted capacity.

chris: cost note — short-term west-eu Dedicated allocation will add ~6-8% to hourly GPU opex vs eu-central standard until backlog clears. tagging for cost center to surface to finance.

sre-oncall: thanks team. if latency re-spikes, escalate to paging rotation and we will open an incident. for now we keep this as a focused thread. :thumbsup:
